Damage Type Resistances?

Can someone who's played the game a lot more than me please comment on whether mobs have resistances to crush, slash, or pierce weapons later on in the game? I haven't seen any yet, but that doesn't mean much since I'm only 1/5 of the way through the game. -Dedridd 06:05, 21 August 2007 (CEST)
